newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Umax Feb sales soar 174 percent.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Umax Feb sales soar 174 percent.

text.p: Taiwan's Umax Data Systems Inc said on Friday sales revenue in February soared 174 percent to T$871 million from T$317 million in February 1996.
The company attributed the revenue growth to rising sales of its scanners and computers. It did not give profit figures.
Umax has set a 1997 pre-tax profit target of T$1.46 billion on sales of T$15.344 billion.
Umax and its U.S. unit Umax Computer Corp are among several Asian manufacturers licensed to design and make Max-compatible clones that run on Apple Computer's Mac OS operating system.
